body:
Phase 2 architecture pass — Dendro R1 Amendment 1.
Read: transitions/0004.json (dendro-r1-p1-a1), PRODUCT.md, ACCEPTANCE_R1.md digest 046c172214a93eaefc1666dc0f0234ffa0e606880afa93e6881e45d3108fae3e, scaffold crates at d724204d5ab1872bb38b42e4864123ebb7e00958, architecture-a1.md and oracle-matrix-a1.md.
Decision: retain five crates and deliver source discovery, privacy-safe normalized event ingestion, identity-only correlation, versioned DuckDB facts with atomic offsets/counters, historical queue/activity analytics, metric reports and ingestion-snapshot trace. Reject legacy analytic schemas without migration. OpenRig/Claude/Codex/Pi required; AGY/Grok discovery/absence visible but not acceptance blockers; watch/Nao/site excluded.
P3 structural adapter rung selects dev.build-sr, one writer in isolated worktree. Workflow high-assurance because private telemetry/data risk; explicit user repository posture autonomous/zero-human-blocking governs person gates. Generic classify/plan output is human-gated/manual degraded and remains recorded unchanged in classification-a1.json/collaboration-plan-a1.json, not relabelled as council approval. Advisory council provided three independent role perspectives; do not weaken assurance or omit QA/review. No publication authorized.
Council evidence: reviewer qitem-20261010171058-1aa05106 concurrence; QA qitem-20261010171052-50a77443 concurrence; builder qitem-20261010171235-b09248c1 concurrence. Reviewer/QA draft-plan concurrence qitem-20261010171301-2257b485 and qitem-20261010171249-d070d0a4. Their findings are disposed in architecture-a1.md and phase3-plan-draft.md, preserving each earlier dissent. Product ambiguities resolved in one phase1 return cycle, transitions/0003→0004; no new semantic return needed.
Measured feasibility testimony: QA ptrace availability smoke exit0/61 stops; full observer coverage is NOT proved. Builder synthetic frozen SQLite shows mode=ro changes SHM, immutable misses WAL; frozen ingest must byte-copy source trio privately then read only copy, while live ingest uses original mode=ro with SHM exception. Builder supports exclusive Claude/Pi input and inclusive Codex input plus one canonical Codex stream; exact mappings recorded in plan. These are attributed peer observations, not my rerun or acceptance verdict.
Proof contracts: oracle-matrix-a1.md AC1-AC12 with <=300-second first ingest/report, numeric source oracle, trace-only replay, independent ptrace source/network observer, privacy tests, alias/symlink/hardlink/swap tests and cargo check/test/clippy/fmt. Sponsor O8 decision remains separately pending. All required phases remain.
Next: Phase3 freezes actual candidate base, contract digests, branch/worktree, files/interfaces/test commands and final safe staging/key/WAL crash ordering. Builder must supply staging feasibility before Phase3 pass; QA observer implementation/negative controls occurs only after Phase4. No writer begins before Phase3 recorded. Phase5 QA precedes Phase6 independent review; orch owns Phase7/8.
